content:
maria: Heads-up: CI on main is red — a bunch of integration jobs failing. Looks like kv-bridge container never reports ready within 30s and tests timeout. Filing here before I start bisecting. @sam @lee

ci-bot: [job failed] integ/kv-bridge-suite — 12/12 tests failed
Build: https://ci.redwood/integrations/12345

sam: can you paste failure logs? is this happening on a single runner or across sharded jobs?

maria: Pasting a snippet from the runner that consistently repros:
```
kv-bridge | INFO  Starting kv-bridge v0.9.2
kv-bridge | WARN  waiting for upstream services
kv-bridge | INFO  ready after 62.347s
test harness | ERROR  healthcheck timed out (30s)
```
We see ready after 62s > 30s timeout.

lee: hmm v0.9.2 was the image bumped yesterday in the infra image update PR (internal#5678). Could be slower startup bc of a migration step.

olivia: can we extend the startup timeout in the pytest fixture to 90s as a stopgap? Or add a retry in the harness.

sam: let's not paper over; need to know if image is the cause. @maria can you kick a rerun with logs preserved? I'll try to bisect between last green and current.

maria: rerun triggered: https://ci.redwood/integrations/12345?rerun=1 — logs are preserved.

ci-bot: rerun started by maria.

oncall-runner: FYI the pool pulling images was reporting higher egress latency around the same window — may explain slower pulls and start delays.

sam: OK starting a bisect on main: I'll run a binary search across the last 8 merges. If anyone has a better suspect PR call it out.

lee: suspect PR is infra-image-update (internal#5678). It added a `db-migrate` step to entrypoint. If that's the culprit we should move migration to prestart or mark it optional in test images.

olivia: quick temp fix: increase fixture timeout and add a small sleep before asserting health to reduce flakes tonight.

maria: Agreed — olivia, can you open a tiny PR to increase fixture timeout to 90s and add logging around readiness? tag it with `ci: hotfix` and I can merge quickly.

olivia: On it. PR: https://git.redwood/olivia/ci-hotfix-bridge-timeout

sam: bisect update: failing commit found — the infra-image-update PR is the first bad. I repro locally by running container; migration step adds 45s on cold start.

lee: confirming — image entrypoint runs `./migrate.sh && start` which waits for db, so in CI where db is mocked it stalls.

maria: For the longer term: change image to run migrations only at build-time or if environment var `RUN_MIGRATIONS=true`. Add healthcheck that doesn't block startup.

olivia: PR merged for timeout increase. CI rerun queued.

ci-bot: rerun completed: integ/kv-bridge-suite — all tests passed ✅

maria: Awesome. Thanks @sam for bisect and @olivia for hotfix. I'll create a follow-up ticket to change the entrypoint and pin test images to avoid this.

lee: creating follow-up issue #234: "avoid blocking migrations in test image; add healthcheck"

maria: Closing thread — leaving the issue for planning. :thumbsup:
